newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline softer with NYMEX, U.S. arb closed.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline softer with NYMEX, U.S. arb closed.

text.p: NWE gasoline softened on Monday as NYMEX unleaded futures fell sharply but dealers said a closed arbitrage window to the U.S. had cushioned the European market from most of the weakness, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded at $200 fob ARA and few players said they were looking at the market, after much of Europe's spot gasoline surplus was sold to transatlantic destinations this month.
Fob cargoes were hard to assess but traders said their price should be close to barge numbers.
